---
name: Agent task
about: A piece of work ready to hand to an agent
---

## Goal

What is true when this is done, in a sentence or two.

## Files

The files or directories the agent may change. Anything else is out of scope.

## Acceptance

The commands to run and what they must show.

## Don't touch

Files, settings and commands that stay as they are.

## PR

How many pull requests, how to merge them, and the expected size.
